# SARVEX picomatch fork

This vendored package is based on micromatch/picomatch commit `0150ed18b7971894bfd1824c8f96d6b63c70ad1f`.

That upstream commit adds detection for glob-star branches and repetition overlap in repeated extglobs, literalizing patterns considered unsafe for regular-expression compilation. It is not represented as an official npm release. The local version suffix `-sarvex.1` identifies this maintained fork and must not be removed or represented as an upstream release.

Upstream: https://github.com/micromatch/picomatch/commit/0150ed18b7971894bfd1824c8f96d6b63c70ad1f
